Premium Library Membership Guide
Sample document for AI Voice Library Assistant testing and demonstrations. Overview
Premium Membership provides enhanced access to library facilities, digital resources, priority
services, and exclusive learning opportunities. Benefits
Feature
Description
Extended Borrowing
Borrow books up to 30 days with renewal options. Higher Borrow Limit
Borrow up to 20 books simultaneously. Digital Library
Unlimited access to e-books, journals, and research databases. Priority Reservations
Reserve books and study rooms before regular members. Research Support
One-on-one librarian consultation. Inter-Library Loan
Request books from partner institutions. Workstations
Access premium computer labs and multimedia stations. Events
Invitations to workshops, seminars, and author sessions. Mobile Access
Use library mobile app for renewals and digital access. Eligibility
Students, faculty, researchers, alumni (where applicable), and approved external members may
apply according to institutional policy. Suggested AI Questions
 What are the benefits of Premium Membership?  How many books can a premium member borrow?  Can premium members access digital journals?  How do I reserve a study room?  What research support is available?
